verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public JSON REST API for reading and writing workspace records. Webhooks give real-time change notifications to a target URL, signed with an `Attio-Signature` header, and a rate-limiting guide documents 429 responses with a `Retry-After` header. Together these cover two-way sync and change detection, but upserts and scale are not shown. Missing for 10: documented upsert/assert endpoint, specific rate-limit quotas, bulk or high-volume sync guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of sync at scale.
